LESSON: BIRTH OF JESUS

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN
Topic 3.1: Birth of Jesus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Birth of Jesus. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the place of Jesus’ birth
2. role play the birth of Jesus Christ e) demonstrate the visit by the shepherds through role playing to signify God’s love. f) colour the drawn pictures of Baby Jesus and His parents at the Manger g) appreciate the birth of Jesus as the saviour of mankind manger. (Luke 2:1-7)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the place of Jesus’ birth
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name the place of Jesus’ birth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. role play the birth of Jesus Christ e) demonstrate the visit by the shepherds through role playing to signify God’s love. f) colour the drawn pictures of Baby Jesus and His parents at the Manger g) appreciate the birth of Jesus as the saviour of mankind manger. (Luke 2:1-7)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to role play the birth of Jesus Christ e) demonstrate the visit by the shepherds through role playing to signify God’s love. f) colour the drawn pictures of Baby Jesus and His parents at the Manger g) appreciate the birth of Jesus as the saviour of mankind manger. (Luke 2:1-7). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Birth of Jesus.
2. Explain Birth of Jesus to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Birth of Jesus.
4. Show that you can: name the place of Jesus’ birth
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Birth of Jesus. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Birth of Jesus important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. name the place of Jesus’ birth
2. role play the birth of Jesus Christ e) demonstrate the visit by the shepherds through role playing to signify God’s love. f) colour the drawn pictures of Baby Jesus and His parents at the Manger g) appreciate the birth of Jesus as the saviour of mankind manger. (Luke 2:1-7)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
